defensive_basket.eligibility: 200 observed ETF sessions; strict majority of SMA63/SMA126/SMA200; equal weights among eligible defensives; preserved single-survivor volatility exception.
defensive_basket.leverage: Defensive capital is carried unchanged in every overlay tier.

sharpe_basis: Annualized daily excess returns over the common net MMF/T-bill proxy; sqrt(252), sample standard deviation. Includes modeled trading costs.
